question: Should schema version 10 and source-revision-first ordering become the supported upgrade and conflict-resolution contract for existing gitcrawl archives?
rationale: Implementation and migration evidence can demonstrate technical behavior, but only the repository owner can accept permanent stored-data semantics and upgrade compatibility policy.

options.title: Accept the contract
options.body: Approve schema 10 and the ordering semantics, then merge after the draft is marked ready and final-head checks complete.

options.title: Narrow the rollout
options.body: Split or gate migration-sensitive workflow and child-hydration portions if the complete persistent-state change is too broad for the next release.

options.title: Keep the draft paused
options.body: Delay merge until another designated persistence owner accepts the archive upgrade and conflict-resolution behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the contract
recommendation.body: Approve schema 10 and the ordering semantics, then merge after the draft is marked ready and final-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The released persistence and migration baseline traces to this owner, who is best positioned to accept its replacement contract.
